newsitem.title: USA: FelCor to offer 10.2 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: FelCor to offer 10.2 mln shares.

text.p: FelCor Suite Hotels Inc said Monday it is offering 10.2 million shares of common stock in a secondary offering to fund hotel acquisitions.
The company said 8.16 million shares will be offered in the United States and Canada, and 2.04 million shares will be offered outside the United States and Canada.

The shares are being offered to fund the acquisition of five ITT Sheraton Hotels from ITT Corp, four Doubletree Guest Suites hotels, two Embassy Suites hotels and the repurchase of 1.2 million shares of stock from Promus Hotel Corp.
Earlier Monday, FelCor and ITT announced an agreement for FelCor to buy five ITT Sheratons for $200 million in cash.
FelCor also said it would invest about $100 million to buy five to 10 Embassy Suites hotels to be developed by Promus.
